meta.name: Konosuba! God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! Legend of Crimson
meta.description: After receiving a warning that Yunyun's hometown is in danger, Kazuma's party is relieved to discover it's only a joke...until it isn't. The Demon King's general has just arrived to obtain The Mage Killer, a weapon with world-ending power.
meta.slogan: We will definitely return alive. Go back to that place.
